summary: Backend-only testing of MigrationOS Stage 1 (Discovery + SRS). All 21 pytest tests passed in ~29s covering projects, prompts (8 seeded), KB upload/build/status/toon/glossary, chat with real OpenRouter LLM call, SRS generate (real LLM)/get/section-edit/freeze/unfreeze/PDF export, GitHub push stub, and audit log. Pilot project auto-seeds correctly and stage_status.Discovery transitions active->frozen->active as expected.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 for create (per REST convention); functional but inconsistent. response_model is Project.
Uses raw `dict` instead of a Pydantic model for project_id — weaker validation; works but no schema validation.
Accept `dict` instead of Pydantic models — no automatic validation of required fields.
When no SRS exists, returns a synthetic empty doc (200) instead of 404 — may mask 'not generated yet' state on the frontend.

action_items: (Optional) Replace `payload: dict` with Pydantic request models in /api/kb/build, /api/srs/generate, /api/srs/freeze, /api/srs/unfreeze for input validation and OpenAPI accuracy.
(Optional) Consider returning 404 from GET /api/srs/{id} when no SRS exists, or add an explicit `exists` flag.
Stages 2-5 still placeholders by design — no action needed for pilot scope.
critical_code_review_comments: FastAPI uses deprecated `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')` — migrate to lifespan context manager (warning only, still functional).
Seed runs on every startup but is idempotent for prompts; project seed checks `count_documents({}) > 0` which prevents re-seed in shared DBs after first project is created (acceptable for pilot).
kb/build accepts dict payload — should use Pydantic model (BuildKBRequest).
Chat endpoint loads history with .to_list(40) but only keeps last 20 per docstring — limit mismatch (cosmetic).
SRS get-empty path returns version 0 with empty sections instead of 404 — frontend cannot distinguish 'never generated' vs 'empty after wipe'.
No rate limiting / auth on any endpoint (acceptable for pilot but worth flagging).
seed_data_creation: Tests upload synthetic PHP (UserController.php with 2 classes/5 methods) and SQL (schema.sql with 3 tables and FK relationships) to the pilot project. A TEST_Project_* is also created via POST /api/projects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pilot project is auto-seeded. The KB for pilot now contains 2 PHP + 1 SQL file from prior runs (uploads are additive — kb/build clears entities but kb_files persist). SRS document exists (version may keep incrementing on each /generate). Real OpenRouter LLM calls take 5-15s each; total suite ~30s. To rerun: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_migrationos.py -v`.
rca of the issue: No issues — all functional tests passed.
